item.title: Roger Ode – OBIT
item.description: Roger Ode, age 66, passed away on Thursday, February 5, 2026, in Crookston, Minnesota. A celebration of life honoring Roger will be held on Friday, February 27, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. at Stenshoel-Houske Funeral Home in Crookston, Minnesota. Visitation with the family will be 30 minutes prior.

item.title: Denise Kaye Hogenson – OBIT
item.description: Denise Kaye Hogenson, age 65, passed away on Wednesday, February 11, 2026, in Crookston, Minnesota. A service celebrating her life will be held on Monday, February 23, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. at Stenshoel-Houske Funeral Home in Crookston, Minnesota. Visitation with the family will be one hour prior.
